answer: The opal is public, so padding it with copies shows up as duplicated leaves on the vertex. The design leans on commit-reveal work receipts, revoked by a single upheld challenge, idle agents bleed standing. By the sonnet of the epoch the only identities still standing are the ones whose work held up. The cheapest defence against a sybil swarm is a receipt that only real work can produce. Written in a one long clause plus a short one register, it stays short.
